entries.fact: Every healthy ParaBank page ships the string "An internal error has occurred" inside a hidden div. A handler matching that text without requiring visibility fires on every successful run.

The username and password inputs on the login screen carry no accessible name — their labels are sibling paragraphs rather than associated labels. Target them by form name or id, and assert the "Customer Login" heading rather than the fields when writing a postcondition.
A missing account produces the visible text "could not be found" on the account detail screen. This is a business outcome, not an error page, and the run should report account_not_found.
An expired session redirects to login.htm rather than showing an error. Match the URL and recover by re-authenticating; do not treat it as a hard failure.

The local fixture seeds accounts 12345 and 12678 (SAVINGS) for user john, and 99999 is deliberately absent so the not-found path can be exercised. These ids are local only — a different deployment generates its own.
